biology.description.generic-naked-demo@1: Generic variant without cocoons, with reproductive diapause, reserves and plug. It does not represent a calibrated species.
biology.description.generic-semiclaustra: Demonstration variant with an open entrance and local outside foraging by the queen. Finite food separate from initial reserves; no calibrated species.
biology.description.generic-microclimate: The queen probes soil before digging, and nurses compare only visited chambers. Pore water is a proxy; chamber climate and species are not calibrated.
Local probing and food stocks by chamber. Deliveries seek known dry locations; spoilage uses the pile’s climate. Brood nutrition still uses a collective budget. No calibrated species.
Relative clay and compaction indices adjust water/heat transport and ceiling support. Fixed pore capacity; density and engineering are not calibrated.
biology.description.generic-fertility-de: Finite reproductive credits per encountered male, viability loss and parentage per egg. Storage capacity and loss rate are not calibrated; depletion changes brood sex, rather than killing the queen.
biology.description.generic-survival-dem: Energy, injuries, local infection and age-related hazard are separate. Demonstration curves and rates do not predict natural species longevity. The queen can consume accessible food in her own chamber.
biology.foundation: Generic {foundation} founding. Cocoons and seasonality are not calibrated by species.

biology.description.generic-effort-demo@: Workers build up effort when moving and digging and recover over time. Load, slopes, detours and local conditions feed the exploratory calculation.
biology.description.messor-narbonne@1: Viveiro’s reference population. Exploratory profile based on the ants Buhl called Messor sancta, probably Messor bouvieri. Worker size, surface walking and seed foraging use specific references.
biology.description.messor-narbonne@2: Exploratory Narbonne profile, likely Messor bouvieri. Prepared seeds, underground walking, reproductive caste sizes and a demonstration Mediterranean calendar.
